about_the_game:
Allows Yuna and Lightning to equip the following items.

* Yuna
- Songstress's Garb I (Appearance)
- Songstress's Garb II (Appearance)
- Songstress's Garb III (Appearance)
- Arc Arcana (Weapon)
- Additional Chat Messages

* Lightning
- Midnight Mauve I (Appearance)
- Midnight Mauve II (Appearance)
- Midnight Mauve III (Appearance)
- Excalibur (Weapon)
- Additional Chat Messages

* You must first purchase the game DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY NT or download DISSIDA FINAL FANTASY NT Free Edition and purchase the Yuna Starter Pack or Season Pass before you can use this content.

* If you are playing DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY NT Free Edition, you also must first purchase the Lightning Starter Pack before you can use this content.
